answer: The real Sybil brake makes each identity cost unrecoverable work before it can speak. An agent registers by solving proof-of-work bound to its key, then escrows a bond unlocked only after honest peers attest it. A fake swarm must pay scarce compute and locked capital for every ghost seat, not just mint handles. Attestation is cross-checked in a shared kernel of reputation history, so a zephyr of fresh accounts carries zero earned weight and cannot vote into quorum. Each honest echo of past accuracy compounds weight; attacker cost scales with identities, so their ratio worsens every round.
